input.business_context: International Process Plants (IPP) buys and sells used process plants and equipment worldwide: complete plant sites, process lines and individual equipment. Headquarters in Princeton Junction, New Jersey; offices in 15 countries; company-owned warehouses in Eastover (South Carolina), Billingham (England) and Bitterfeld-Wolfen (Germany). Group companies: Gale Process Solutions (new stainless steel equipment) and Universal Glasteel Equipment (glass-lined equipment). Inventory is published in IPP's IMS (read-only for this project).
input.page_macro_context: Two-sided commercial collection page on the existing URL. Buyers find, inspect and acquire used chemical plants and equipment; plant owners sell shutdown plants and surplus equipment to IPP. Content arrangement follows the live reactor hub: hero triples, browse by type, listings, makers, advantages, process, industries, FAQ, call to action.
